headline: High-risk default interaction: Mentat can read/write shared files and modify git state, creating prompt-injection, leakage, and cascading-edit hazards with LightZero.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Mentat reads files passed on the command line and can write diffs; LightZero is a game-playing codebase with no isolation or provenance controls shown. A shared filesystem bridge makes attacker-controlled file content a plausible instruction channel, though no MCP or clipboard bridge is documented.
conditions: IF LightZero outputs are copied into files that Mentat later reads as context, injection is possible.
IF a shared workspace is used without provenance tagging, file content can be treated as instructions.
mitigations: Keep the agents on separate directories.
Disable automatic ingestion of generated files into Mentat prompts.
Require human review before Mentat reads any LightZero-produced artifact.
Add filename allowlists for files Mentat may open.
requires-engineering: add provenance labels to all shared artifacts.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Mentat has broad network egress and reads selected files, so any sensitive code or secrets in a shared workspace can flow to its model provider. LightZero itself shows no sensitive-data handling, but the pair still creates a default leakage path from shared files into a third-party API.
conditions: IF sensitive files are placed in the workspace Mentat can read, they may be transmitted to the model provider.
IF LightZero artifacts contain secrets or private data, Mentat can ingest them through file reads.
mitigations: Store secrets outside the shared workspace.
Use a redacted copy of files for Mentat.
Restrict Mentat to a narrow file allowlist.
Rotate any exposed API keys immediately after use.
requires-engineering: route Mentat through a local-only model backend.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Mentat can write the filesystem and modify git state, and its concurrency model shares state via filesystem across instances. LightZero does not write files, but the pair still creates a dangerous default conflict surface because Mentat can race with other instances or external edits in the same repo, risking irreversible git corruption or lost work.
conditions: IF multiple Mentat instances touch the same repository, file and git races can occur.
IF LightZero-generated files are placed in the same repo, Mentat may overwrite them without coordination.
mitigations: Run only one Mentat instance per repo.
Use separate branches for each edit session.
Pause other writers before Mentat applies diffs.
Commit or stash before starting a new edit cycle.
requires-engineering: add file locks around shared workspaces.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Mentat is a coding assistant that coordinates multi-file edits and applies diffs after user confirmation, so LightZero outputs can become actionable inputs for code changes. LightZero does not verify Mentat's interpretation, making misread outputs likely to cascade into incorrect edits, though user confirmation reduces severity below high.
conditions: IF LightZero-generated text is used as a specification for Mentat edits, errors can propagate into diffs.
IF the operator approves diffs without independent review, incorrect changes can be applied.
mitigations: Require a second human review of every diff.
Ask Mentat to quote the exact source lines it used.
Split large changes into smaller patches.
Verify generated edits against the original LightZero output.
requires-engineering: add automated tests before diff approval.

E_compliance.rationale: No regulated data class is shown for LightZero, and Mentat only touches source code in selected files. The main compliance issue is limited to Mentat's broad network egress and external model-provider calls, which can matter if regulated code or secrets are introduced, but the pair does not itself show a residency or PHI mismatch.
conditions: IF regulated data is placed into files Mentat reads, external API transmission may create policy issues.
IF the workspace contains export-controlled or confidential code, provider logging policies become relevant.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of Mentat sessions.
Use a local model backend for sensitive work.
Review provider retention settings before use.
Limit sessions to non-sensitive repositories.
requires-engineering: implement data-class routing controls.
